_source._why_this_file_exists: WVdnr.gov serves an expired TLS certificate, so the site cannot be fetched. Nate supplied the official PDF instead. This is a TRANSCRIPTION of the summary table, not the regulations themselves.
_read_this_before_printing_anything: The pamphlet says it plainly: nothing in it preempts the law. The West Virginia Code and the Code of State Rules control, and where they conflict with this, they win.
AFTER valid_through THIS FILE IS DANGEROUS, not merely stale. Seasons move every year. Do not print a WV date from here on or after 2027-07-01 - replace the file first.

Many seasons are COUNTY-SPECIFIC or zone-specific and this table does not carry the county lists. Where a row says 'Selected Counties', the counties are in the page this row cites and MUST be checked before naming a date as if it were statewide.
Bag and possession limits for deer and bear are not in this table at all - they are on pages 13-18 and 33-39 and vary by county and permit class.
Always cite WVDNR and say which season year. Never present any of this as advice.

electronic_registration_note: Species marked registration:true must be electronically registered (checked). Instructions on page 6 of the pamphlet.
changes_2026_27: Season dates and open counties changed for antlerless deer, fall wild turkey and black bear.
Bear and turkey may be taken with any weapon legal during the statewide Mountaineer Heritage Season within Logan, McDowell, Mingo and Wyoming counties (page 32).
Youth and Class Q permit holders may take one antlered deer during the Special Split Youth and Class Q Seasons (page 27).
Detailed chronic wasting disease Q&A moved online to WVdnr.gov (page 12).
